subject.title: fix(memory-core): keep same-agent session hits in memory recall under tree visibility (#103732)

question: Should session-backed memory recall widen the documented `tree` visibility boundary only when `tools.sessions.visibility` is omitted?
rationale: The proposed behavior changes access to historical transcripts and makes the boundary depend on configuration provenance, so tests cannot determine the intended product and security policy.

options.title: Preserve one tree policy
options.body: Keep omitted and explicit `tree` equivalent, retaining the current history boundary and using explicit `agent` visibility for broader same-agent recall.

options.title: Approve a recall exception
options.body: Define and document a distinct same-agent recall policy across entry points, with live proof for allowed and denied cases.

recommendation.title: Preserve one tree policy
recommendation.body: Keep omitted and explicit `tree` equivalent, retaining the current history boundary and using explicit `agent` visibility for broader same-agent recall.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged EV-001 work introduced the exact memory-search visibility contract being changed.
